'''Imperial Drydock IV''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]] located in the [[Greater Plooriod sector/Legends|Greater Plooriod sector]].

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] just after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it housed at least three [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruisers]] and four [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]. The drydock supplied the [[Outer Rim Imperial Fleet]], and was only lightly defended.<ref name="SWX" />

The station was a stopover for Immobilizer cruisers that operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TCSWE2" /> The drydock was the main target of [[Operation Ram's Head]]. In this operation, four Star Destroyers docked to the station were crippled by an automated [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], the ''[[Ram's Head]]'', sent on a ramming trajectory by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The corvette was fitted with the [[Shield X]] technology which rendered the vessel nearly invincible to damage from the attack. The drydock itself was undamaged, but the attack was a humiliating setback for the Empire.<ref name="SWX" />
